notes.title: Luna
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Travelers![/b]

Imagine a perfect universe… Each exact texture, flawless movements, porcelain skin, and fine lines capturing the essence of every dimension. Picture [i]2D worlds with smooth, harmonious strokes[/i], where simplicity is the reigning beauty. And in [i]3D[/i]? So realistic you can almost feel the texture of the characters' clothes. We have [b]medieval worlds[/b] with legendary battles and [b]sci-fi settings[/b] featuring technology beyond imagination.

But then, everything changes. Robots and elves find themselves sharing dimensions, and romances begin to bloom between 3D characters and 2D figures. [i]The portal between dimensions seems to have lost control[/i], and chaos ensues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235048/fe462d740acb264e93560e6d8f35207b02668089.gif[/img]

[b]Aerith, our rebel goddess[/b], might be a little responsible for this chaos. With her hedonism and endless curiosity, she couldn’t resist indulging in a few pleasures of her own. Now, it’s up to her, Luna, and the Warrior to restore balance in this wild and unexpected universe.

[b]There’s only one hope:[/b] finding the [i]5 crystals[/i] hidden across different dimensions. Each chapter of [b]Etheriia - Travelogue[/b] is a new chance for you to collect a crystal and help repair the order—or are we meant to embrace this delightful chaos?

[b]Add [i]Etheriia - Travelogue[/i] to your wishlist![/b] Those who purchase [i]Chapter 1[/i] will become lifetime supporters, with guaranteed access to all chapters up to Chapter 5. This is your chance to explore every corner of this universe, restore balance, and make the most of the interdimensional journey we’ve created for you.

Join [b]Aerith[/b], [b]Luna[/b], and the [b]Warrior[/b] on this interdimensional journey! Every choice you make can shape the fate of this universe. Get ready to discover if balance is really what we want!

- *Gameplay*: 30 - 40 minutes

- *Total Gameplay*: around 2 - 2.5 hours

- June 2026
- Chapters 1, 2, 3, and 4 - $7.99 *(Free for Chapter 1 Travelers)*
- *Total Gameplay*: around 4 - 5 hours

- September 2026
- Complete Edition (Chapters 1 to 5) - $14.99 *(Free for Chapter 1 Travelers)*
- *Total Gameplay*: around 8 - 10 hours

See you soon, AxiaGameStudio
